concerns: The PR bundles unrelated backend changes (specifically, the CRM query optimization migration and Java tests) under the frontend tag PR.
The save handler gracefully/silently succeeds even when the backend API fails, which could hide real persistence errors from the user.
The controller returns JPA entity domain models directly (e.g. Dialog, Message) instead of standard DTOs (e.g. DialogDTO, MessageDTO).
Standard error handlers / ExceptionHandlers are defined locally inside the DialogController instead of a global @ControllerAdvice class.
Using standard multipart/form-data with binary formats is correct, but could benefit from explicitly documenting specific expected ZIP structures for tdata uploads.
